Analysis code for *Spatial mapping reveals convergent cytotoxic inflammation and divergent immune architectures in panniculitis* (Nature Communications, 2026).

1. `01_IMC_read_data.Rmd` - read steinbock output
2. `02_IMC_marker_quality_check.Rmd` - marker quality control
3. `03_IMC_Clustering.Rmd` - clustering, cell-type annotation and spatial analysis
4. `04_IMC_Figures.Rmd` - IMC figures
5. `05_NanoString_Figures.Rmd` - nCounter figures
6. `06_IF_IL1B_NLRP3_LPS_LTA.Rmd` - immunofluorescence quantification

Patient data are not included; see the README of the repository.
